recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Future work should not re-expand the current core category value set unless CDS reverses FHIR-39458; profile-specific R4/R5 compatibility concerns should be handled in the relevant profile or version-specific guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-31677 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested that Detected Issue Category include v3 ActCode concepts where concept is-a _ClinicalActionDetectedIssueCode so CAREGAP could be used for DEQM Gaps In Care DetectedIssue.
initial_application: No source commit directly tagged FHIR-31677 was found. The Jira comments say the issue was added in FHIR-39309; commit b0e4d55a7158f6dcfb787c29d3971dfdd6db31ec applied that same request by adding _ClinicalActionDetectedIssueCode to source/detectedissue/valueset-detectedissue-category.xml.
additional_context: FHIR-39458 was later Applied/Persuasive for R6 and decided that DetectedIssue.category should include only category codes while DetectedIssue.code should use a separate detailed code value set. Commit 34181b9f2184a72b527d9f5b26c234c0c07669ed implemented that split, and the current detectedissue-code value set includes _ClinicalActionDetectedIssueCode.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Re-adding _ClinicalActionDetectedIssueCode to detectedissue-category would undo the later FHIR-39458 decision; the current source keeps high-level categories in detectedissue-category and detailed clinical-action detected issue codes in detectedissue-code.
